name: Icon
description: Renders a named icon from the built-in registry, so apps never import an icon library directly. Case-insensitive; unknown names render nothing.

props.name: name
props.description: Registry name, case-insensitive (see the icon gallery). Empty renders nothing.

props.name: label
props.description: Sets aria-label; omit to mark the icon decorative.

example:
<s-icon name="refresh" />
<s-icon name="loading" spinning label="Loading" />
<s-icon name="check" size="lg" />
